## Show and tell 🎤 {.smaller}

⏱️ 20 min · breakout rooms of 3

Each person gets **5 minutes**:

1. Share your screen and run your tool — even if it barely works 🙂
2. Say what it does and where you are stuck
3. The others give **one** question and **one** suggestion 💡

. . .

Rule: comment on the **code**, never the person 💛

::: notes
0–20 min. Rehearsal for the oral exam, in a safe setting. Say that out loud — it lowers exam anxiety.
:::

## Things I saw this block 🔍 {.smaller}

Common fixable issues:

- Functions that `print` instead of `return` ⚠️
- Everything in one long block — no functions yet 🧩
- No error handling: missing file → crash 💥
- Commits: one giant "final" instead of steps 📈

. . .

All four are on the grading list. All four take 10 minutes to fix. ⏱️

::: notes
20–30 min. Replace with what you actually saw in block 1 — specific beats generic.
:::

## A tiny checklist ✅ {.smaller}

Before week 14, your project needs:

- [ ] Runs from the terminal with an argument ⚙️
- [ ] At least 3 functions with clear names
- [ ] Reads a real file 📄
- [ ] Prints or saves output
- [ ] Friendly message when something is missing 🛡️
- [ ] README with an example command
- [ ] Commits spread over several days 📈

::: notes
30–35 min. Tell them to copy this into their PROJECT.md as a literal checklist.
:::

## Work time 🛠️ {.smaller}

⏱️ Rest of the block

- ✋ Raise your hand and I join your room
- 👥 Rooms stay open for pair work
- 💬 Chat for quick questions

. . .

**Before you leave: commit, push, and tick one box on the checklist.** 💾

::: notes
35–75 min. Same rotation as block 1. Prioritise students you did not reach earlier.
:::
